verdict.rationale: Smithery documents service tokens for AI agents that are scoped to specific operations and resources, for example list and call tools only on connections in a given namespace matching a metadata filter. API keys can also be scoped to namespaces. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of token scoping, and documentation of token expiry/TTL and revocation controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Service tokens let you safely expose Smithery to browsers, mobile apps, and AI agents without leaking your API key.
This token can list and call tools on connections in `my-app` where `metadata.userId` is `user-123` — nothing else.
Resources within a namespace can be managed by anyone with the appropriate API key scoped to that namespace
